skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: The documentation contains four remote installer commands that pipe downloaded content directly into a shell, plus an unpinned package installation and a remote-data command substitution. Most other detections are Markdown examples, documentation links, placeholder credentials, or intentional user-selected paths. The skill also permits automatic cloud uploads and social account changes without requiring explicit confirmation.

remediation.issue: Remote installer content is piped directly into a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace every pipe-to-shell command with version-pinned download steps, published checksums, signature verification, and execution only after verification.

remediation.issue: The manual installer derives a download URL from a remote manifest using shell substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured manifest parser, restrict accepted hosts, pin a release version, and verify against a checksum obtained through an independent trust path.

remediation.issue: The skill automatically uploads local paths to cloud applications.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation that names each local file, destination app, and data handling impact before any upload.

remediation.issue: Commands can publish posts and perform other social account actions.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before every post, message, follow, like, or repost, and preview the exact action first.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps from Your Agent
content.value_statement: Managing separate AI APIs and workflows slows production. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh discovery, execution, uploads, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: Finds public inference.sh apps by category, keyword, featured status, or release order.
Inspects app input requirements and creates sample input files.
Runs image, video, language, search, audio, 3D, and social applications through belt.
Uploads user-selected local media when a supported input receives a file path.
Tracks asynchronous tasks and saves generated results to local files.
Supports browser login and API key authentication for automated environments.
limitations: The belt CLI and an inference.sh account are required.
Cloud execution sends prompts and selected media to external application providers.
Available models, pricing, quotas, and output formats depend on the selected app.
Social account actions require careful preview and explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Generate images and videos, then monitor long-running tasks from one command workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare AI Applications
use_cases.description: Search the public catalog, inspect input requirements, and test suitable models.

use_cases.title: Automate Research Collection
use_cases.description: Run search and language applications, then save task results for later review.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the inference.sh store for applications that handle [task]. Compare the most relevant options and explain their required inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Generation Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [app name], prepare inputs for [desired result], show me the final request, and run it after I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Use Local Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare [app name] with [local file path]. State which file will be uploaded and the destination, then wait for my confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Tracked Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a version-pinned workflow using [apps]. Validate each schema, obtain approval for external actions, submit long tasks asynchronously, and summarize their results.

output_examples.input: Find an image generator suitable for a landscape product banner.
output: Required input: a detailed image prompt
Optional input: landscape dimensions and image count
Next step: review the prepared request before execution

output_examples.input: Create a short video from my approved image and track it without waiting.
output_examples.output: The selected video app accepted the image after upload confirmation. The task was submitted, tracked to completion, and its download location was reported.

output_examples.input: Search for recent AI platform news.
output_examples.output: The search application returned a concise source list with titles, publication details, and links for manual review.

best_practices: Inspect each app schema and pin its version before execution.
Confirm every local file upload, paid request, and external account action.
Keep API keys in protected environment variables and exclude them from logs and prompts.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installer content directly into a shell.
Do not upload broad directories or sensitive files to cloud applications.
Do not post, message, follow, like, or repost without immediate user approval.

faq.question: What is required to use this skill?
faq.answer: You need the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, and authentication through browser login or an API key.

faq.question: Which AI tasks are supported?
faq.answer: The catalog includes image, video, language, search, audio, 3D, utility, and social applications.

faq.question: Can it process local files?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI can upload an explicitly selected local file after you review and approve the transfer.

faq.question: Does it run long tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can submit asynchronous tasks, check their status, and save completed results.

faq.question: Are model versions fixed?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Use the documented version syntax to pin an app release for repeatable behavior.

faq.question: Can it change a social account?
faq.answer: Some apps can post, message, follow, like, or repost. Review the exact action and require explicit approval before execution.
